equity_bridge.note: Interim report balance sheet: NCI HK$67,977k. Flows are consolidated, so NCI is deducted once here (adaptations rule c).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr and eps_5yr_cagr (2.5-2.6%), rounded up for the H1-2026 run-rate (+2.8%) and FY2025 (+5.0% incl. acquisitions)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGRs are not usable as the growth anchor: FY2022 equity fell HK$395m because the common-control acquisition of Winner Food (HK$332.8m consideration above book) was charged to equity under merger accounting, and FY2021-22 buybacks took out HK$182m. Owner-FCF CAGRs (12.8% 5yr, 26.9% 3yr) are inflated by the FY2024-25 capex trough (HK$112-144m against HK$250m in FY2022-23) and the FY2025 inventory release; they are not a growth anchor either.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income, applied across the whole history. The owner series grows faster than reported FCF on a 3yr view only because interest income collapsed from HK$27.9m (FY2023) to HK$9.1m in FY2025 as HIBOR fell; SBC is immaterial throughout (0.02-0.07% of revenue).

scenario_narratives.base: Nissin Foods HK is a mature, cash-generative premium instant-noodle franchise (Cup Noodles, Demae Iccho) with ~62% of revenue in the Chinese Mainland and ~38% in Hong Kong and other regions, no debt and HK$1.7bn of net cash. Base case: 3-3.5% revenue growth driven by Mainland store coverage and channel penetration, Hong Kong flat; Adjusted EBITDA margin 16.0-16.5%; the Zhuhai Jinwan factory (completion 2029) lifts capex to 6-6.5% of revenue for three years; 50% dividend payout continues. Value is roughly the current price.
scenario_narratives.bull: Mainland premium-noodle penetration accelerates under the consumption-stimulus policy, volume growth runs 5-6% in local currency, distribution (Itochu partnership) and snacks add new revenue lines, and mix plus the new automated factory lift Adjusted EBITDA margin to 18%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Hong Kong leakage and Mainland price competition flatten revenue, input-cost inflation compresses Adjusted EBITDA margin to 14%, and the committed factory capex is spent into flat demand. The HK$1.7bn net cash and 50% payout keep the downside bounded by the balance sheet rather than by solvency.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on HKD flows at a 9% HKD cost of equity, with the company's Adjusted EBITDA (not the cash-flow-statement D&A basis) as the margin anchor, total D&A of 4.4% of revenue, interest income stripped and net cash added once in the bridge, NCI deducted once at book, and SBC (0.06% of revenue) expensed with a flat share count. Risk is carried in the scenario flows and weights, not in the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Chinese Mainland volume: H1-2026 growth was +4.5% in HKD but -0.1% in local currency; the base case assumes genuine low-single-digit volume growth resumes
Hong Kong consumption leakage to the Greater Bay Area: HK segment result -16% in H1-2026 on flat revenue
Input costs (palm oil, wheat flour, packaging) and the ability to price through in a competitive Mainland market
Zhuhai Jinwan factory capex (2027-2029) is modelled at 6-6.5% of revenue without a disclosed budget; a larger or slower project moves the base case
Parent Nissin Foods HD owns ~70%; related-party procurement, royalties and common-control acquisitions (FY2022 Winner Food, HK$428.5m FY2024 acquisitions) can transfer value away from minorities
Interest income on HK$1.7bn of cash is stripped; if the cash is never distributed or deployed above the cost of capital the bridge overstates its value to minorities
The Metrics CSV EBITDA (491) understates the company's Adjusted EBITDA (623) by the depreciation capitalised in inventories; multiples built from the CSV look ~27% more expensive than they are

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 5.80-9.69 HKD
data_sources.financials: research/1475.HK/Reports/1475.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2018-FY2025 annual, H1-2024 to H1-2026 interim); 1475.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (cash flow statement lines 5036-5135, note 11 depreciation line 7195-7215, segment note 6760-6800, Adjusted EBITDA line 604-615); 1475.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt (balance sheet 1430-1510, share capital note 14, liquidity section, segment note 2020-2030)
data_sources.qualitative: research/1475.HK/Reports/1475.HK_Analysis.json (bull/bear points, guidance, Zhuhai budget); FY2025 annual report chairman's statement and business review; H1-2026 interim management discussion and future prospects.

inputs.share_count_basis: 1,043,691,480 ordinary shares issued and fully paid at 30 June 2026 (interim report note 14); unchanged since 1 January 2025. Share awards are satisfied from shares bought on-market by the award-scheme trustee (HK$1.8m FY2025), so there is no grant dilution; diluted weighted average for H1-2026 EPS is the same count. Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Equity-settled share-based payment' HK$2,572k (1475.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:5044); no cash taxes on equity awards (awards settled from trustee-held shares bought on-market)
inputs.buyback_note: No share repurchases in FY2023-FY2025 or H1-2026. FY2021 HK$156.4m and FY2022 HK$26.0m buybacks reduced the count from 1,074.3m to 1,043.7m. The HK$1.8m/yr of on-market purchases is award-scheme funding, not a buyback; the flat count is a modelling convention the company funds only through those trustee purchases.
inputs.net_cash_note: Company-stated net cash HK$1,709.2m at 30 June 2026 (interim report, Liquidity section) = cash and cash equivalents 1,612.997 + time deposits over three months 96.186 + restricted deposits, less lease liabilities. Total debt is lease liabilities only (2.112 current + 0.208 non-current = 2.32); the Group has no bank borrowings and HK$820m of undrawn facilities. net_debt = 2.32 - 1,709.2 = -1,706.9.
inputs.wacc_rationale: HKD flows discounted at an HKD-built cost of equity. HKD is pegged to USD: 10-year HK Exchange Fund Note ~3.7%, equity risk premium 5.5%, beta ~0.8 for a packaged-food staple (0.8 x 5.5 = 4.4pp), plus ~0.9pp for the small free float (Nissin Foods HD holds ~70%) and Chinese Mainland exposure = ~9.0%. Zero debt, so WACC = cost of equity = 9.0%. The same rate is used in all three scenarios; cyclical and China risks are carried in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities (HK$2.32m) sit in total_debt; right-of-use depreciation (HK$12.8m FY2025) stays inside the D&A path; lease cash cost (~HK$8.2m/yr principal + interest, 0.2% of revenue) is immaterial and is covered by the capex path. No lease_cost_pct_path, so the lease is charged once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated flows; non-controlling interests deducted once in the equity bridge at book (HK$68.0m at 30 June 2026). NCI share of profit was HK$8.1m in FY2025 (2.4% of profit), so a capitalised deduction would be ~HK$90-100m, i.e. ~HK$0.03/share more; the difference is immaterial and the book figure is auditable.
inputs.ebitda_basis_note: EBITDA margin path is anchored to the company's Adjusted EBITDA (FY2025 HK$622.8m, 15.6%; FY2024 HK$612.5m, 16.1%; H1-2026 HK$330.8m, 16.0%), which is before net interest, tax, PPE and ROU depreciation and amortisation, and excludes FVTPL and capital-nature items. The Metrics CSV EBITDA (FY2025 491.2) is built from the cash-flow-statement D&A add-back (31.4), which omits the HK$143.7m of depreciation capitalised into inventories and released through cost of sales (annual report note 11: total depreciation 169,736 less 143,740 capitalised). Total FY2025 D&A is 175.2 (4.4% of revenue), which is the da_pct anchor. That same inventory-capitalised depreciation is why reported OCF runs ~HK$140m/yr above net income plus the cash-flow D&A line: it surfaces as a 'decrease in inventories'.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company, routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2, non-US consumer manufacturer, with the adaptations file applied: HKD-built WACC, single lease treatment, NCI charged once, interest income stripped against net cash in the bridge, near-SBC-zero market). FY0 = FY2025 (year ended 31 December 2025); FY2026 is Y1 and is ten months elapsed, with H1-2026 revenue +2.8%, gross margin 35.3% (+1.7pp), Adjusted EBITDA margin 16.0% and attributable profit +11.6%. Anchors (price, net cash, shares, NCI) are from the 30 June 2026 interim balance sheet. Interest income (HK$9.05m FY2025, 0.6% on the pile as HIBOR fell) is stripped because net cash is 4.5x the owner-FCF base. Tax is modelled as a 26% cash rate: HK 16.5% / PRC 25% blend plus PRC dividend withholding; FY2025 ETR 26.1%, FY2023 27.1%, FY2024's 31.5% inflated by non-deductible impairments. FY2024 operating profit was depressed by HK$135.9m of impairments (PPE 83.9, ROU 7.9, intangibles 21.4, goodwill 22.7) and is not a base year. FY2022 revenue is the restated figure after the common-control combination. Capex path carries the Zhuhai Jinwan factory (land bought FY2025 for RMB30.7m, total planned investment over RMB240m, completion targeted 2029) as a 2027-2029 step-up to 6-6.5% of revenue before settling at 5%, against a 2018-2025 average of 5.3%. Working-capital capture is -10% of the revenue change: inventories plus trade receivables exceed trade payables by ~HK$660m, so growth consumes cash. Analysis.json (written in parallel) was read after the first build: it confirms the Zhuhai Jinwan budget at RMB240m+ through 2029 (inside the 6-6.5% capex step-up), the FY2025 external-revenue mix of 58.5% Mainland / 41.5% HK-and-other, Q1 FY2026 revenue +4.1%, and no numeric revenue or EPS guidance; the driver paths were not changed by it.

bear.narrative: Hong Kong consumption leakage to the Greater Bay Area keeps the HK segment shrinking (segment result already -16% in H1-2026), Chinese Mainland volume stalls in local currency (-0.1% in H1-2026) as domestic brands (Master Kong, Uni-President) compete on price, and palm oil / wheat inflation cannot be passed through; Adjusted EBITDA margin falls back to 14% (below the FY2024 16.1%). The Zhuhai factory is built into flat demand, so D&A rises against revenue. Terminal growth 1.5% with a 14x cap.

base.narrative: Revenue grows 3-3.5% for four years (Chinese Mainland volume growth in Cup Noodles / Demae Iccho from wider store coverage, Hong Kong flat), fading to 2.5%. Adjusted EBITDA margin edges from the H1-2026 16.0% to 16.5% as premiumisation and procurement gains hold and the Zhuhai Jinwan factory (2029) brings automation; the factory lifts capex to 6-6.5% of revenue in FY2027-29 before settling at 5%. Tax 26%, growth consumes 10% of incremental revenue as working capital.

bull.narrative: The 15th Five-Year Plan consumption push and low premium-noodle penetration in inland China turn into 5-6% growth for four years (local-currency volume growth rather than FX translation), the Itochu distribution partnership and snack line extensions add a second leg, and Adjusted EBITDA margin reaches 18% on mix, scale and the new factory. Capex runs slightly higher to fund the growth.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: 25/50/25 rather than the 15/50/35 house default. Bull weight is cut because the bull case needs Mainland local-currency volume growth to re-accelerate from ~0% (H1-2026) and the margin to reach a level the company has never reported, two independent things. Bear weight is raised to 25% because the HK segment result fell 16% in H1-2026 and Mainland growth was FX translation, not volume; it is not raised further because there is no solvency, covenant or single-customer risk, and the net cash is 27% of the market cap.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
